name: FFS_SERVICE_REQUEST_HIST
description: Used to store service request submit history.

columns.name: SERVICE_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: ID of the related support request. Reference to the FFS_SERVICE_REQUEST -> SERVICE_REQUEST_ID.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: ID of a parent action_log record.

columns.name: ACTION_TIME
columns.description: Time of the service request action (Gmt).

columns.name: OPERATION_TIME
columns.description: Time when this operation is performed by user (GMT).

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Sequential ID of transaction that defines an order of operations inside of the system.

columns.name: INTERFACE
columns.description: Interface the action is performed from.

columns.name: SCREEN_ID
columns.description: ID of the screen the action is performed from (reserved for a future use).

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: ID of the user the operation is performed by.

columns.name: USER_AGENT_ID
columns.description: Id of the user agent which was used by action.

columns.name: OPERATION
columns.description: Identifier of the performed operation.

columns.name: REQUEST_DATE
columns.description: Date of the submit of the service request.

columns.name: TYPE_ID
columns.description: Submitted service request type ID.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Link to the related resource ID - FFS_RESOURCE->RESOURCE_ID.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Link to the related activity ID - FFS_ACTIVITY->ACTIVITY_ID.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ID
columns.description: Reference to the related inventory ID - FFS_INVENTORY->INVENTORY_ID.

columns.name: NEW_VALUE
columns.description: New values of affected fields and properties.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SERVICE_REQUEST_HIST_ID
columns.description: Contains unique identifier of the row. System generated.
